title: Concavity of the distance to the complement of a convex set (Simon 2.8 proof, C1(b))
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every convex set U ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), the function d(x) := infDist(x, Uᶜ) (Metric.infDist; by Mathlib convention infDist x ∅ = 0) is concave on U in Mathlib's sense ConcaveOn ℝ U d: for all x, y ∈ U and a, b ≥ 0 with a + b = 1, a·d(x) + b·d(y) ≤ d(a•x + b•y). Openness of U is not assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)), Convex ℝ U → ConcaveOn ℝ U (fun x ↦ infDist x Uᶜ)
